description: DUT discards a TCP packet with Data Offset greater than the segment length (RFC 793 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
If Data Offset declares more header bytes than the segment carries on the wire, the parser would walk past the buffer end. DUT must drop.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data with Data Offset > segment length.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT ack.

[Pass condition]
No DUT ACK to oversize Data Offset.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_unexpected_ack — DUT acked oversize Data Offset

verdicts.Pass: DUT discarded segment with oversize Data Offset — normal
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_ack: DUT acked segment with oversize Data Offset
